LOADOUT-WOUNDED_POWER.title: Wounded
LOADOUT-WOUNDED_POWER.description: At [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Wounded[/gold], become [gold]Stunned[/gold], then remove all Wounded.
LOADOUT-PAINFUL_STABS_POWER.playerDescri:
Whenever you deal unblocked Attack damage to an unstunned enemy, apply [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Wounded[/gold] to that enemy.
At [blue]10[/blue] [gold]Wounded[/gold], stun them.
